fields.name: Bedroom Sets
fields.short: Full bedroom suites – bed, wardrobe, dresser and side tables designed to work as one harmonious set.
fields.description: A bedroom set from SALAAR's HOME turns an empty room into a complete, elegant retreat. Every set is designed as one cohesive collection – bed, wardrobe, dresser and side tables – so the finish, hardware and style always match perfectly. Choose from classic wood tones or modern minimal designs, all handcrafted from solid wood with premium fittings.
fields.material: Solid wood (oak, acacia or walnut finish) with premium MDF accents and smooth, durable lacquer.
fields.dimensions: Sets are made in full, queen and king sizes – exact dimensions vary by model.
fields.seo_description: Explore handcrafted bedroom sets at SALAAR's HOME – beds, wardrobes, dressers and side tables designed as complete, matching collections.

fields.name: Wardrobes
fields.tagline: Storage that keeps your space beautiful
fields.short: Spacious wardrobes with sliding or hinged doors, built-in mirrors and smart internal storage.
fields.description: A well-designed wardrobe quietly keeps your home organized and calm. Our wardrobes combine generous storage with clean, beautiful lines – soft-close doors, adjustable shelves, drawers and hanging space for everything you own. From slim two-door designs to full wall-to-wall wardrobes, every piece is built to last a lifetime.
fields.material: Solid wood frame with premium laminate or lacquer finishes and soft-close hardware.
fields.dimensions: From 1.2 m to 2.4 m wide, 2.1 m to 2.7 m tall – custom dimensions available.
fields.seo_description: Discover quality wardrobes at SALAAR's HOME – sliding and hinged door designs, smart internal storage, made to measure.

fields.name: Side Tables
fields.short: Elegant bedside and accent tables in solid wood – the finishing touch for any room.
fields.description: The right side table finishes a room. Handcrafted from solid wood with clean joins and smooth finishes, our side tables bring warmth and function to the bedside, the sofa corner or the hallway. Available in a range of heights and styles to match any interior – simple, elegant and built to last.
fields.material: Solid wood tops with durable lacquer finish; metal or wood legs depending on design.
fields.dimensions: Approx. 40 x 40 x 55 cm – multiple styles and heights available.
fields.seo_description: Shop elegant solid wood side tables at SALAAR's HOME – bedside and accent tables in many styles and finishes.

fields.name: Dressers & Mirrors
fields.short: Dressers with storage plus matching mirrors – a classic, elegant corner for your room.
fields.description: A dresser is more than a place to get ready in the morning – it is a statement piece. Our dressers offer deep, smooth-gliding drawers for all your essentials, topped with a beautiful vanity mirror that completes the look. Classic and contemporary designs available in rich wood tones that grow more beautiful with age.
fields.material: Solid wood construction with hand-finished lacquer and premium mirror glass.
fields.dimensions: Dressers approx. 120 x 45 x 80 cm; mirrors approx. 90 x 110 cm – models vary.
fields.seo_description: Browse dressers and vanity mirrors at SALAAR's HOME – classic wooden dressers with elegant matching mirrors.
